text:
elaine: small postmortem follow-up: at 03:16 UTC we saw a brief spike in retries + TLS failures after a route promotion. filing thread to track owners + quick mitigations.

ben: yes, traces show clients with cached DNS hit an older IP which ended up on fallback pool that had just rotated certs. mismatch window ~70s.

hiro: reproduced in lab with TTL=360s. SDKs that retry quickly amplify the issue.

maya: immediate mitigation idea: during rollouts, mark fallback pools as cordoned until cert-check passes. simple gating.

elaine: proposed action items:
- cert preflight + enforce same-serial across pools (owner: hiro, ETA: 48h)
- add fallback TLS-gate probe before advertising pool (owner: maya, ETA: 72h)
- lower edge DNS TTL during active rollouts 360->90 (owner: ben, ETA: 24h)
- dashboard + alert for cross-region retry surge >1.4x (owner: elaine, ETA: 36h)
- doc entry for recurring pattern + quarterly runbook review (owner: elaine, ETA: EOW)

ben: TTL change will require a registrar push. I'll schedule a 30m window and coordinate netops. script I'll run (sandbox tested):
```
# set TTL to 90s
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id ZEDGE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"edge.redwood.ai.","Type":"A","TTL":90,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"1.2.3.4"}]}}]}'
```
ETA tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

hiro: cert preflight plan: add `curl https://pool-x/_internal/cert` and compare `serial` + `notBefore` for all pools; if mismatch, pause rotation and alert. I'll open PR.

maya: gating plan: implement a handshake-health check that verifies SNI + cert chain on candidate fallbacks. will add to LB readiness checks and include rollback steps.

elaine: i've created tracker ISSUE-5377: https://redwood-internal/triage/ISSUE-5377 and added the items.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window for DNS TTL change on 2026-07-12T09:30Z (owner: ben).

ben: PR for registrar automation: https://github.com/redwood/netops/pull/118 (sandbox pass).

hiro: cert preflight PR draft: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1024. adding unit tests for serial compare.

maya: LB gating branch pushed: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1027. staging canary scheduled. includes `infra rollback lb-gate --to previous` command.

elaine: acceptance test: simulate route flip with common SDKs and verify SNI failures <0.5% for 30m. owners: hiro + maya.

ben: will be on-call for TTL change and post updates to this thread.

hiro: started cert preflight work.

maya: running gating canary tests now.

elaine: thanks team. please update here when started/completed. we'll monitor retry metrics for 72h post-change.

ops-bot: Automated: follow-up checklist updated in ISSUE-5377 by elaine.
